sn33.3:1.2: nisinno kho Vacchagotto paribbājako Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca || ||
sn33.3:1.3: Ko nu kho bho Gotama hetu ko paccayo yānīmāni anekavihitāni diṭṭhigatāni loke uppajjanti ||
sn33.3:1.5: Neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti vā ti || || 4
sn33.3:1.6: Saññāya kho Vaccha aññāṇā saññāsamudaye aññāṇā saññānirodhe aññāṇā saññānirodhagāminiyā paṭipadāya aññāṇā ||
sn33.3:1.7: evam imāni anekavihitāni diṭṭhigatāni loke uppajjanti ||
sn33.3:1.8: Sassato loko ti vā Asassato loko ti vā || pe ||
sn33.3:1.9: Neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti vā ti || || 5
sn33.3:1.10: Ayaṃ kho Vaccha hetu ayam paccayo yānimāni anekavihitāni diṭṭhigatāni loke uppajjanti ||
sn33.3:1.11: Sassato loko ti vā Asassato loko ti vā || pe ||
sn33.3:1.12: Neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti vā ti || || 1-3 Sāvatthi || ||
